units.rawText: My job? I listen to confessions and grant salvation. I steer people towards righteousness and clean up the mess after the shooting's stopped. Other than that last task, the others are all just for show.

units.rawText: When criminals confess their sins, they make themselves sound very innocent, so would they even need a counsellor like me to grant them absolution? They've already absolved themselves in their own minds.

units.rawText: Dolls can't forgive their own sins, yet humans can do that easily enough.
